claims.text: The hotel has a central yet secluded location just steps from St Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge.

findings.quote: With its central yet secluded location, just steps from iconic **St Mark's Square** and the **Rialto Bridge**

claims.text: The hotel is within walking distance of Saint Mark's Square in one direction and the Rialto Bridge in the other.

findings.quote: Within walking distance of Saint Mark's Square in one direction and Rialto Bridge in the other

claims.text: The hotel has a private dock for gondolas and water taxis.

findings.quote: a private dock for gondolas and **water taxis**

claims.text: The hotel's interiors blend rich colors, precious fabrics and design pieces.

findings.quote: the hotel boasts a beautiful blend of rich colors, precious fabrics and design pieces

claims.text: The lobby is a succession of small Levantine parlors.

findings.quote: the lobby, rather than transitioning into a modern, open design, is a succession of small Levantine parlors

claims.text: Rooms are decorated in silver, brown and lilac, with wallpapers and damask designs that evoke Venice's textile tradition.

findings.quote: Silver, brown and lilac set the tone, with wallpapers and damask designs that evoke the Serenissima’s textile tradition

claims.text: Several rooms have balconies and views over St Mark's.

findings.quote: several with balconies and views over St Mark’s

claims.text: The Splendid Heritage Suites are a tribute to Venice's textile tradition, each with a bedroom and a separate sitting area.

findings.quote: A tribute to the Serenissima’s textile tradition, each Splendid Heritage Suite measures 40 square meters and offers absolute privacy and ultimate comfort, with a spacious bedroom and a separate sitting area

claims.text: Le Maschere restaurant, led by Venice-born Executive Chef Massimo Livan, serves Venetian-inspired dishes focused on fresh local fish.

findings.quote: Helmed by **Executive Chef** **Massimo Livan**, a celebrated Venice-born chef, the restaurant offers a sophisticated yet authentic cuisine that tells the essence of the lagoon, enhancing the freshest local fish
dishes inspired by the Venetian tradition, reimagined with a fresh, contemporary touch

claims.text: The Lounge Bar has large picture windows looking onto the canal, where gondolas glide by.

findings.quote: With its large picture windows, the Splendid Venice Lounge Bar is the ideal place to take a break and gaze lazily around at the magnificent views of the canal, where the gondolas silently slide by

claims.text: Among the hotel's craft experiences, guests can make their own Venetian papier-mache mask at Ca' Macana.

findings.quote: Craft Experiences
Ca' Macana
Make your very own Venetian papier-mâché mask, ready to wear for the next Carnival ball

claims.text: The Family Connecting Room is designed for families travelling with children.

findings.quote: Ideal for families travelling with kids, the Family Room offers an abundance of space for your Venice getaway

claims.text: Splendid Venice traces its roots to the 16th century, when part of it formed the Black Hat Inn.

findings.quote: Splendid Venice can trace its roots all the way to the 16th century, when part of it formed the Black Hat Inn

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has a private double terrace with views of Saint Mark's, the Campanile and the city's rooftops.

findings.quote: With a double private terrace and unparalleled Saint Mark's views
with a private double terrace, with a view of the Campanile and the city's rooftops

claims.text: The Altana is a traditional Venetian rooftop terrace on top of the hotel, serving cocktails and wine with views over the city.

findings.quote: Enjoy Venezia from above: located on top of the Splendid Venice's roof, our altana - the quintessential Venetian rooftop terrace
an exclusive location to take in breathtaking views while savoring a perfectly crafted cocktail, a glass of wine

claims.text: The hotel's craft experiences include a visit to an authentic Murano glass factory at Berengo Studio.

findings.quote: Berengo Studio
Step into an authentic Murano glass factory and discover the magic of glass as it takes shape before your eyes, coaxed by master artisans

claims.text: Deluxe Canal View rooms have details recalling classic Venetian style and canal views.

findings.quote: A spacious sanctuary for your vacation in Venice with details that recall classic Venetian style and wonderful canal views

claims.text: The mixologist experience on the rooftop Altana is offered on summer evenings.

findings.quote: In the summer evenings, enjoy the mixologist experience on our panoramic rooftop Altana

claims.text: WhataHotel notes compact room sizes, typical of a historic Venetian building.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the central Venice location.
